   City Council Agenda Report
  December 12, 2023

TO:  Honorable City Council

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

BY:  Theresa Devoy, CMC, City Clerk

SUBJECT:  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

Background:

Annually, City Council selects one of its members to serve as Mayor and one to serve as
Vice Mayor. Following is the procedure for reorganization:

1.  The City Clerk will declare that the next item of business shall be the selection of a
  Mayor and a Vice Mayor for the upcoming year.

2.  The City Clerk declares that nominations are in order for the office of Mayor. The
  City Clerk accepts nominations; a second to the nomination is not necessary. If
  there are no further nominations, the City Clerk will close the nominations and take
  a roll call vote. If more than one nomination, a vote will be taken in the order of the
  nomination. Following the vote(s), the City Clerk declares the Mayor elected.

3.  The newly elected Mayor will preside over the election of the Vice Mayor in the
  same manner as outlined for the Mayor and conduct the remainder of the meeting.

Fiscal Impact: N/A

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Plan 2023 Implementation: N/A

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends City Council turn the meeting over to the City Clerk to initiate the
process for the selection of the Mayor and Vice Mayor.
